data.title: 卡芙卡 · 空间站虚空小提琴
data.description: 【卡芙卡 · 空间站虚空小提琴】黑塔空间站幽蓝全息回廊之中，反物质军团入侵的警报声回荡在空旷大厅。卡芙卡优雅侧身架起虚空中的无形小提琴，指尖拉动看不见的琴弓，酒红长发在气流中微扬，神情从容自若犹如在指挥一场盛大的交响乐——「听到了吗？这是为艾利欧预见的未来所奏响的序曲。」
data.location: 空间站「黑塔」全息控制回廊
data.action: 优雅侧身架起虚空中的无形小提琴，单手虚拉琴弓，眼眸低垂神情从容优雅
data.lighting: 冷蓝全息光幕与头顶科幻环形灯带
data.promptProse: Kafka turns sideways in Herta Station's holographic corridor, raising her hands to bow an invisible violin amid the invasion alarm. Her burgundy-black shoulder coat, white lace-collared shirt and gloved fingers retain their deliberate elegance in the dynamic cowboy view. Blue projection panels layer down the empty hall. Overhead ring lights illuminate her hair and coat seam, while cool hologram light reflects across the space where the imagined instrument rests.
